source: The command opens the browser with the auth link, so you are signed in with one click. A browser without the link asks for the 6-digit auth code from the terminal. The server keeps running until you stop it with Ctrl+C. It watches the files, so edits from the editor or the CLI show in the UI at once.
text: 此指令會以驗證連結開啟瀏覽器，因此只需點一下即可登入。未使用該連結的瀏覽器會要求輸入終端機中的 6 位數驗證碼。伺服器會持續執行，直到你按 Ctrl+C 停止。它會監看檔案，因此從編輯器或 CLI 所做的修改會立即顯示在 UI 中。
